bio: I left a modest publishing career in the Philippines where I worked as proofreader, copyeditor, and research manager for different publishing entities before Saipan beckoned, where I worked as a journalist full time. Then I found myself warming up to the healthcare industry as I transitioned into becoming a nursing assistant. And the adventure continues.

skills.title: CLINICAL SKILLS
skills.description: Ten years of hands-on patient care as a nursing assistant, grounded in empathy and steady hands.

skills.title: WRITING & EDITING
skills.description: Two decades of reporting, proofreading, and copyediting across print newsrooms and publishers.

skills.title: WEB DESIGN
skills.description: Building clean, personal sites and layouts that tell a clear story, like this one.

skills.title: CONTENT STRATEGY
skills.description: Shaping a publication's voice, from research and structure to the final published page.
